clips.title: The story
paras: Deliver the Signet is a quest in which a traveler carries a recovered family ring to High Elder Talaanis Shadowsong in Valanaar. The delivery brings tragic confirmation of his nephew's demise on Zephras Isle, while opening new opportunities to assist the local peacekeepers.

When an adventurer journeys toward the settlement of Valanaar, they carry with them the Shadowsong Family Signet recovered from an isolated tower. Entrusted with this grim token, travelers seek out Talaanis Shadowsong, the High Elder of Zephras Isle. Beloved by his people despite widespread local hardships, Talaanis must face the painful confirmation that his nephew has perished, receiving condolences alongside the reclaimed heirloom.

Upon receiving the signet ring in Valanaar, High Elder Talaanis expresses heartfelt gratitude despite his profound grief. Recognizing the skill of the traveler who retrieved the relic, Talaanis directs them to Captain Valennia Stormfist, leader of the Valanaar peacekeepers. Facing strained circumstances and mounting pressures, the settlement welcomes any aid capable protectors can offer.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Since you are going to Valanaar anyway, please deliver the signet ring you recovered from the tower to Talaanis Shadowsong in Valanaar.

He will want this back, and more importantly, he will want to learn the fate of his nephew. Talaanis is the High Elder of Zephras Isle and more importantly, he is a good man who is well loved by the people, despite our current hardships. It pains me to think of how he will react to this news. Please express my condolences for his loss.

clips.title: Progress
paras: What is that you have for me? Oh... Oh no.

clips.title: Completion
paras: I... Am very sorry to hear that my nephew is dead. I thank you kindly for recovering this, and bringing it to me.

It's not common that such capable young shen'dorei come down from the highlands. If you need work, please speak with Valennia Stormfist, the captain of the peacekeepers here in Valanaar. These days we need all the help we can get.
